flag_yellow.note: A yellow flag, said when another car is the likely cause. sector: 1, 2 or 3, where that car is (the incident), not where the driver is. A line naming the car follows.

flag_double_yellow.text: Double yellow, sector {sector}. Be ready to stop.
flag_double_yellow.note: A double yellow flag: the track may be blocked. sector: 1, 2 or 3, where the car causing it is, when it is known. A line naming the car follows.

cause.solo_crash: a car off on its own

flag_yellow_cause.note: Said right after a yellow flag when the game gives its reason.

flag_yellow_ahead.note: A yellow flag when the car causing it could not be identified (no sector is made up). Followed by the game's reason when it gives one.

flag_double_yellow_ahead.text: Double yellow ahead. Be ready to stop.
flag_double_yellow_ahead.note: A double yellow flag when the car causing it could not be identified. Followed by the game's reason when it gives one.

flag_yellow_driver.note: Said right after a yellow when another car is the cause. driver: its name; cause: what it is doing (the game's reason, or slow on track when it gives none).

situation.off_track: off. Rejoin carefully, cars are coming
situation.stopped: stopped on track. Get going carefully

flag_yellow_self.note: The yellow flag is about the driver's own car (he is off or stopped; the game shows the yellow to the car that causes it too), so a short note instead of a flag call. situation: off_track or stopped. Said once per incident; the clear call is not said for it.

flag_clear.note: The yellow is over and the track is clear again.

flag_blue.note: A faster car a lap or more ahead is behind the driver. driver: its name.

flag_blue_unknown.text: Blue flag, let the faster car through.
flag_blue_unknown.note: Blue flag when the lapping car could not be identified.

flag_slow_car.note: The white flag: a slow car on the track ahead.

flag_slow_car_driver.note: The white flag when the slow car ahead on track could be identified. driver: its name.

final_lap.note: The race's last lap has begun.

flag_red.text: Red flag. Slow down and come back to the pits.

flag_black_white.text: Black and white flag: warning for driving standards.

flag_track_limits.note: The black and white flag right after the game invalidated the lap (the driver cut the track). Always the driver's own flag.

flag_black_orange.text: Black and orange flag: mechanical problem, box now.
flag_black_orange.note: Race control calls the car in for a mechanical problem.

disqualified.note: The driver is disqualified (black flag or race state).

retired.text: You are out of the race.
retired.note: The driver's race state became retired or did not finish.

chequered.note: The driver took the chequered flag. position: the finishing position.

chequered_no_position.note: The driver took the chequered flag; the position is not known.

fcy_start.text: Full course yellow. Safety car on track.

fcy_pits_open.note: During the caution the pit lane opens.

fcy_pits_lead_lap.text: Pits open for the lead-lap cars.
fcy_pits_lead_lap.note: During the caution the pit lane opens only for the cars on the lead lap.

fcy_last_lap.note: The caution ends at the end of this lap.

fcy_restart.note: The race resumes after the caution.

fcy_halt.text: Race halted: follow the safety car into the pits.
fcy_halt.note: The race is halted under the caution.

penalty_drive_through.text: Drive-through penalty. Box to serve it.
penalty_drive_through.note: The driver must drive through the pit lane.

penalty_stop_go.text: Stop-and-go penalty. Box to serve it.
penalty_stop_go.note: The driver must stop in the pit box and go.

penalty_served.note: The drive-through or stop-and-go penalty was served.

rival_disqualified.note: Another driver was disqualified. driver: the name.

rival_out.note: Another driver retired. driver: the name.

radio_check.text: Radio check from the AMS2 connector.
radio_check.note: A test of the announcement path, sent by hand.

engineer_test.note: A test message for the race engineer, sent by hand. text: a free sentence.
